Reglas de Seguridad Firestore (v1): rules_version = '2'; service cloud.firestore { match /databases/{database}/documents {*_\n\n// Parejas: cada usuario solo ve/edita su doc match /parejas/{coupleId} { allow read, update, delete: if request.auth != null && request.auth.uid == coupleId; allow create: if request.auth != null && request.auth.uid == coupleId;\n\n    // subcolecciones\n    match /coincidencias/{providerId} {\n      allow read, write: if request.auth != null && request.auth.uid == coupleId;\n    }\n    match /favoritos/{providerId} {\n      allow read, write: if request.auth != null && request.auth.uid == coupleId;\n    }\n    match /tareas/{taskId} {\n      allow read, write: if request.auth != null && request.auth.uid == coupleId;\n    }\n    match /mensajes/{threadId} {\n      allow read, write: if request.auth != null && request.auth.uid == coupleId;\n      match /mensajes/{msgId} {\n        allow read, write: if request.auth != null && request.auth.uid == coupleId;\n      }\n    }\n    match /presupuestos/{budgetId} {\n      allow read, write: if request.auth != null && request.auth.uid == coupleId;\n      match /items/{itemId} {\n        allow read, write: if request.auth != null && request.auth.uid == coupleId;\n      }\n    }\n  }\n\n  // Proveedores: de momento solo lectura pÃºblica (o restringir si hay login proveedor)\n  match /proveedores/{providerId} {\n    allow read: if true;\n    allow write: if false; // gestionado por backend/ingestiÃ³n\n    match /chunks/{chunkId} { allow read: if true; }\n    match /tables/{tableId} { allow read: if true; }\n  }\n\n  // Eventos analÃ­ticos: solo escritura autenticada\n  match /analytics_events/{eventId} {\n    allow create: if request.auth != null;\n    allow read: if false;\n    allow update, delete: if false;\n  }\n}_\n} 1 2 3. Cloud Functions (TypeScript - functions/src/index.ts): // functions/src/index.ts import * as functions from 'firebase-functions'; import * as admin from 'firebase-admin'; import { Pool } from 'pg'; // Si haces sincronizaciÃ³n con Postgres admin.initializeApp(); const db = admin.firestore();_\n\ntype Couple = { profile: { budget_min: number; budget_max: number; ubicaciÃ³n?: { latitud: number; longitud: number; ciudad?: string }; Ã¡reas?: string[]; style?: string[]; values?: string[]; guest_count?: number; date_pref?: string; language?: string; }; preferences?: { distance_km?: number; price_sensitivity?: number; // 0..1 eco_priority?: number; // 0..1 vendor_priorities?: Record<string, number>; }; };\n\ntype Provider = { nombre: string; ubicaciÃ³n?: string; calificaciÃ³n?: number; rango_precio?: string; // 'bajo'|'medio'|'alto' categorÃ­as?: string[]; atributos?: Record<string, string>; descripciÃ³n_md?: string; };\n\nfunction priceBandToNumeric(band?: string): number { if (!band) return 0.5; const b = band.toLowerCase(); if (b.includes('bajo')) return 0.25; if (b.includes('alto')) return 0.85; return 0.55; // medio por defecto }\n\nfunction styleMatchScore(coupleStyles: string[] = [], provCats: string[] = []): number { if (!coupleStyles.length || !provCats.length) return 0.5; const setP = new Set(provCats.map(s => s.toLowerCase())); let hit = 0; coupleStyles.forEach(s => { if (setP.has(s.toLowerCase())) hit++; }); const jacc = hit / (new Set([...coupleStyles, ...provCats]).size || 1); return Math.max(0.2, Math.min(1, 0.5 + jacc)); // ancla suave }\n\nfunction categoryCoverageScore(areas: string[] = [], provCats: string[] = []): number { if (!areas.length) return 0.5; const setP = new Set(provCats.map(s => s.toLowerCase())); const covered = areas.filter(a => setP.has(a.toLowerCase())).length; return covered ? Math.min(1, 0.6 + covered / Math.max(areas.length, 1)) : 0.35; }\n\nfunction ratingScore(r?: number): number { if (!r) return 0.55; return Math.min(1, Math.max(0.4, (r / 5) * 0.9 + 0.1)); }*\n\nfunction budgetCompatScore(band: string | undefined, min: number, max: number, priceSensitivity = 0.6): number { const pb = priceBandToNumeric(band); // 0..1 const target = (min + max) / 2; // Normaliza target a una escala relativa (heurÃ­stica simple) const t = Math.max(0.05, Math.min(0.95, target / 60000)); // 60k como referencia const diff = Math.abs(pb - t); const base = 1 - diff; // 1 si coincide perfecto return 0.4 + base 0.6 (0.5 + priceSensitivity / 2); }\n\nfunction ecoScore(values: string[] = [], ecoPriority = 0.0, provCats: string[] = [], attrs?: Record<string, string>): number { if (!ecoPriority) return 0.5; const sigs = ['eco', 'sostenible', 'kilÃ³metro 0', ' km 0', 'local', 'bio', 'reciclado']; const provText = (provCats.join(' ') + ' ' + Object.values(attrs||{}).join(' ')).toLowerCase(); const hit = sigs.some(s => provText.includes(s)); return hit ? Math.min(1, 0.6 + 0.4 ecoPriority) : Math.max(0.3, 0.5 - 0.3 ecoPriority); }\n\nfunction distanceScore(couple: Couple, provider: Provider): number { // Marcador de posiciÃ³n: si no tienes geocodificaciÃ³n aÃºn, retorna neutral. // MÃ¡s adelante, calcula Haversine y compara con preferences.distance_km. return 0.55; }_\n\nfunction computeMatch(c: Couple, p: Provider) { const w = { style: 0.22, category: 0.18, rating: 0.14, budget: 0.24, eco: 0.12, distance: 0.10 }; const s_style = styleMatchScore(c.profile.style, p.categorÃ­as); const s_cat = categoryCoverageScore(c.profile.Ã¡reas, p.categorÃ­as); const s_rat = ratingScore(p.calificaciÃ³n); const s_bud = budgetCompatScore(p.rango_precio, c.profile.budget_min, c.profile.budget_max, c.preferences?.price_sensitivity || 0.6); const s_eco = ecoScore(c.profile.values, c.preferences?.eco_priority || 0, p.categorÃ­as, p.atributos); const s_dist = distanceScore(c, p);_\n\nconst score = s_style * w.style + s_cat * w.category + s_rat * w.rating + s_bud * w.budget + s_eco * w.eco + s_dist * w.distance;\n\nconst reasons: string[] = [];\nif (s_style >= 0.7) reasons.push(\"Estilo encaja (boho/minimalista u otros).\");\nif (s_bud >= 0.7) reasons.push(\"Rango de precio compatible con tu presupuesto.\");\nif ((p.calificaciÃ³n || 0) >= 4.3) reasons.push(Muy bien valorado (${p.calificaciÃ³n}/5).);\nif (s_cat >= 0.7) reasons.push(\"Cubre Ã¡reas que te interesan (p. ej., finca/foto/decoraciÃ³n).\");\nif (s_eco >= 0.7) reasons.push(\"Enfoque sostenible alineado con tus valores.\");\nreturn { score: Number(score.toFixed(3)), reasons: reasons.slice(0, 3) };\n}\n\n// Activador: recalcula coincidencias cuando cambia el perfil de la pareja export const onCoupleWrite = functions.firestore .document('parejas/{coupleId}') .onWrite(async (change, context) => { const after = change.after.exists ? change.after.data() as Couple : null; if (!after) return; // Obtener // un subconjunto de proveedores rÃ¡pido (ej. por categorÃ­a principal) â€” v1: todos (cuidado en producciÃ³n) const snap = await db.collection('proveedores').limit(5000).get(); const coupleId = context.params.coupleId; const batch = db.batch(); const matchesColl = db.collection('parejas').doc(coupleId).collection('coincidencias');\n\nlet ranked: { id: string; score: number; reasons: string[] }[] = []; snap.forEach(doc => { const p = doc.data() as Provider; const { score, reasons } = computeMatch(after, p); ranked.push({ id: doc.id, score, reasons }); }); ranked.sort((a, b) => b.score - a.score); const top = ranked.slice(0, 100);\n\n  // guarda top-N\n  top.forEach((m, i) => {\n    const ref = matchesColl.doc(m.id);\n    batch.set(ref, {\n      puntuaciÃ³n: m.score,\n      razones: m.reasons,\n      rango: i + 1,\n      explicado_en: admin.firestore.FieldValue.serverTimestamp()\n    }, { merge: true });\n  });\n  await batch.commit();\n});_\n// (Opcional) FunciÃ³n HTTPS para explicar por LLM un match concreto export const explicÃ³MatchLLM = functions.https.onCall(async (data, context) => { // data: { CoupleId, ProviderId } // AquÃ­ llamarÃ­as a tu LLM (RouteLLM/OpenAI/Claude) con un aviso estructurado. // Devuelve explicaciÃ³n en 2-3 frases y un puntaje 1-10 normalizado. return { ok: true, message: \"Placeholder LLM explicaciÃ³n.\" }; });\n\n// (Opcional) Sincronizar Postgres/SQL cuando cambie un proveedor const pgPool = new Pool({ connectionString: process.env.PG_CONN_STR }); export const onProviderWriteSyncSQL = functions.firestore .document('proveedores/{providerId}') .onWrite(async (change, context) => { const after = change.after.exists ? change.after.data() as Provider : null; const id = context.params.providerId; const client = await pgPool.connect(); try { if (!after) { await client.query('DELETE FROM providers_table WHERE firebase_id=$1', [id]); return; } await client.query(  INSERT INTO providers_table (firebase_id, nombre, ubicacion, categorias_json, descripcion_markdown,   rating, price_range)           VALUES ($1, $2, $3, $4, $5, $6, $7)           ON CONFLICT (firebase_id) DO UPDATE   SET nombre=$2, ubicacion=$3, categorias_json=$4, descripcion_markdown=$5, rating=$6, price_range=$7  , [id, after.nombre, after.ubicaciÃ³n || null, JSON.stringify(after.categorÃ­as || []), after.descripciÃ³n_md || null, after.calificaciÃ³n || null, after.rango_precio || null]); } finally { client.release(); } });\n\n1 2 5. LÃ³gica Cliente-Side (Ejemplos): 3 4 * \"Carrusel/Tinder\" de Proveedores (SelecciÃ³n Diaria): // SelecciÃ³n de carrusel v1 async function getDailyCarousel(coupleId: string) { const mRef = db.collection('parejas').doc(coupleId).collection('coincidencias'); const snap = await mRef.orderBy('rango').limit(200).get(); const all = snap.docs.map(d => ({ id: d.id, ...(d.data() as any) })); const top = all.slice(0, 80); const tail = all.slice(80, 200); // Explora 20% aleatorio del tail const explore = tail.sort(() => Math.random() - 0.5).slice(0, 20); const pool = [...top.slice(0, 80), ...explore]; // Baraja y toma 20 return pool.sort(() => Math.random() - 0.5).slice(0, 20); }*\n\n1 * MensajerÃ­a Interna (Modelo de Mensaje): { \"from\": \"couple\", \"to\": \"provider-foo\", \"text\": \"Hola! crean\n**SoluciÃ³n**: Los Ã­ndices tardan 1-3 minutos. Verifica en la consola web.\n\n### âŒ Error al desplegar reglas\n**SoluciÃ³n**: Revisa la sintaxis en `firestore.rules` lÃ­nea por lÃ­nea.\n\n---\n\n## ðŸ“š Arquitectura UNIO - Centro Inteligente\n\n### Collections Principales:\n\n#### 1. **`parejas/{coupleId}`** - Perfil de pareja\n- `/tareas` - Tareas de boda\n- `/favoritos` - Proveedores guardados\n- `/coincidencias` - Matches del motor (escritura solo Cloud Functions)\n- `/mensajes` - Threads con proveedores\n- `/presupuestos` - GestiÃ³n financiera\n\n#### 2. **`proveedores/{providerId}`** - Directorio de proveedores\n\n#### User-Specific Collections (under `/users/{userId}/`)\n- **favoritos** - Saved providers with timestamps\n- **tareas** - Wedding tasks with status, deadlines, and categories\n- **invitados** - Guest list with RSVP tracking\n- **presupuesto** - Budget items with payment tracking\n- **mesas** - Seating arrangements with guest assignments\n- **evento** - Event details (ceremony & reception)\n- **galeria** - Media metadata with privacy controls\n- **aniversarios** - Anniversary tracking and reminders\n\n#### Global Collections\n- **proveedores** - Provider directory with ratings and locations\n- **proveedores/{id}/reviews** - Provider reviews and ratings\n- **experiencias** - Real wedding stories and testimonials\n- **experiencias/{id}/comentarios** - Comments on wedding stories\n- **foros** - Forum posts for community discussions\n- **foros/{postId}/mensajes** - Threaded forum discussions\n- **concursos** - Active contests\n- **concursos/{id}/participaciones** - Contest participation tracking\n\n### 3. Firebase Storage\n- User photo galleries\n- Provider images\n- Profile photos\n- QR codes for guests\n- Progress tracking for uploads\n- Bulk upload support\n\n### 4. Firebase Cloud Messaging\n- Push notifications\n- RSVP updates\n- Task reminders\n- Budget alerts\n- Forum notifications\n\n## Project Structure\n\n```\nsrc/\nâ”œâ”€â”€ lib/\nâ”‚   â””â”€â”€ firebase/\nâ”‚       â”œâ”€â”€ config.ts                    # Firebase initialization\nâ”‚       â”œâ”€â”€ types.ts                     # TypeScript interfaces & enums\nâ”‚       â”œâ”€â”€ auth-service.ts              # Authentication operations\nâ”‚       â”œâ”€â”€ firestore-service.ts         # Database CRUD & real-time\nâ”‚       â”œâ”€â”€ storage-service.ts           # File upload/download\nâ”‚       â”œâ”€â”€ messaging-service.ts         # Push notifications\nâ”‚       â”œâ”€â”€ wedding-utils.ts             # Wedding-specific utilities\nâ”‚       â”œâ”€â”€ index.ts                     # Main exports\nâ”‚       â””â”€â”€ hooks/\nâ”‚           â”œâ”€â”€ use-auth.ts              # Authentication hook\nâ”‚           â”œâ”€â”€ use-firestore.ts         # Firestore hooks\nâ”‚           â””â”€â”€ use-storage.ts           # Storage hook\nâ””â”€â”€ routes/\n    â””â”€â”€ index.tsx                        # Main wedding planner UI\n```\n\n## Environment Variables\n\nA `.env` file has been created in the root directory with placeholder values. **You MUST replace these with your actual Firebase credentials.**\n\n```env\nVITE_FIREBASE_API_KEY=your_api_key_here\nVITE_FIREBASE_AUTH_DOMAIN=your_project_id.firebaseapp.com\nVITE_FIREBASE_PROJECT_ID=your_project_id\nVITE_FIREBASE_STORAGE_BUCKET=your_project_id.appspot.com\nVITE_FIREBASE_MESSAGING_SENDER_ID=your_sender_id\nVITE_FIREBASE_APP_ID=your_app_id\nVITE_FIREBASE_MEASUREMENT_ID=your_measurement_id\n```\n\n**âš ï¸ IMPORTANT**: If you try to run the app without configuring Firebase, you will see a helpful error screen with step-by-step instructions to set up Firebase correctly.\n\n## Firebase Console Setup\n\n### 1. Create Firebase Project\n1. Go to [Firebase Console](https://console.firebase.google.com/)\n2. Click \"Add Project\"\n3. Follow the setup wizard\n4. Enable Google Analytics (optional)\n\n### 2. Enable Authentication\n1. Navigate to Authentication > Sign-in method\n2. Enable Email/Password\n3. Enable Google (add OAuth client)\n4. Enable Facebook (configure Facebook app)\n5. Enable Apple (configure Apple app)\n\n### 3. Create Firestore Database\n1. Navigate to Firestore Database\n2. Click \"Create database\"\n3. Start in production mode\n4. Choose a location\n\n### 4. Set Up Security Rules\n\n```javascript\nrules_version = '2';\nservice cloud.firestore {\n  match /databases/{database}/documents {\n    // User-specific data\n    match /users/{userId}/{document=**} {\n      allow read, write: if request.auth != null && request.auth.uid == userId;\n    }\n\n    // Providers (public read, admin write)\n    match /proveedores/{providerId} {\n      allow read: if true;\n      allow write: if request.auth != null;\n\n      match /reviews/{reviewId} {\n        allow read: if true;\n        allow create: if request.auth != null;\n        allow update, delete: if request.auth != null &&\n          resource.data.userId == request.auth.uid;\n      }\n    }\n\n    // Wedding stories (public read)\n    match /experiencias/{experienciaId} {\n      allow read: if true;\n      allow write: if request.auth != null &&\n        request.auth.uid == resource.data.authorId;\n\n      match /comentarios/{comentarioId} {\n        allow read: if true;\n        allow create: if request.auth != null;\n        allow update, delete: if request.auth != null &&\n          resource.data.userId == request.auth.uid;\n      }\n    }\n\n    // Forum (public read, authenticated write)\n    match /foros/{postId} {\n      allow read: if true;\n      allow create: if request.auth != null;\n      allow update, delete: if request.auth != null &&\n        request.auth.uid == resource.data.authorId;\n\n      match /mensajes/{mensajeId} {\n        allow read: if true;\n        allow create: if request.auth != null;\n        allow update, delete: if request.auth != null &&\n          resource.data.userId == request.auth.uid;\n      }\n    }\n\n    // Contests (public read, admin write)\n    match /concursos/{concursoId} {\n      allow read: if true;\n      allow write: if request.auth != null;\n\n      match /participaciones/{participacionId} {\n        allow read: if true;\n        allow create: if request.auth != null;\n        allow update, delete: if request.auth != null &&\n          resource.data.userId == request.auth.uid;\n      }\n    }\n  }\n}\n```\n\n### 5. Set Up Storage\n1. Navigate to Storage\n2. Click \"Get started\"\n3. Start in production mode\n\n### 6. Storage Security Rules\n\n```javascript\nrules_version = '2';\nservice firebase.storage {\n  match /b/{bucket}/o {\n    // User files\n    match /users/{userId}/{allPaths=**} {\n      allow read: if true;\n      allow write: if request.auth != null && request.auth.uid == userId;\n    }\n\n    // Provider files\n    match /providers/{providerId}/{allPaths=**} {\n      allow read: if true;\n      allow write: if request.auth != null;\n    }\n  }\n}\n```\n\n### 7. Enable Cloud Messaging\n1. Navigate to Cloud Messaging\n2. Generate a new key pair for VAPID\n3. Add the public key to your environment variables\n\n## Usage Examples\n\n### Authentication\n\n```typescript\nimport { useAuth } from ' @/lib/firebase';\n\nfunction MyComponent() {\n  const { user, signIn, signUp, signInWithSocial, signOut } = useAuth();\n\n  // Email/Password sign in\n  await signIn('user @example.com', 'password');\n\n  // Social sign in\n  await signInWithSocial('google');\n\n  // Sign out\n  await signOut();\n}\n```\n\n### Firestore Operations\n\n```typescript\nimport { useCollection, useFirestore } from ' @/lib/firebase';\nimport type { Tarea } from ' @/lib/firebase/types';\n\nfunction TaskManager({ userId }: { userId: string }) {\n  // Real-time collection subscription\n  const { data: tasks, loading } = useCollection<Tarea>(\n    `users/${userId}/tareas`,\n    undefined,\n    'deadline',\n    'asc',\n    undefined,\n    true // Enable real-time updates\n  );\n\n  // CRUD operations\n  const { create, update, remove } = useFirestore<Tarea>(\n    `users/${userId}/tareas`\n  );\n\n  // Create task\n  await create({\n    title: 'Book venue',\n    description: 'Find and book the perfect venue',\n    status: TaskStatus.PENDING,\n    category: TaskCategory.VENUE,\n  });\n\n  // Update task\n  await update(taskId, { status: TaskStatus.COMPLETED });\n\n  // Delete task\n  await remove(taskId);\n}\n```\n\n### File Uploads\n\n```typescript\nimport { useStorage } from ' @/lib/firebase';\n\nfunction GalleryUpload({ userId }: { userId: string }) {\n  const { upload, uploading, progress } = useStorage();\n\n  const handleUpload = async (file: File) => {\n    const path = `users/${userId}/gallery/${Date.now()}_${file.name}`;\n    const url = await upload(path, file);\n    console.log('Uploaded to:', url);\n    console.log('Progress:', progress);\n  };\n}\n```\n\n### Wedding-Specific Utilities\n\n```typescript\nimport {\n  searchProviders,\n  getBudgetSummary,\n  getRSVPStats,\n  bulkImportGuests\n} from Get budget summary\nconst budget = await getBudgetSummary(userId);\nconsole.log('Total budget:', budget.total);\nconsole.log('Paid:', budget.paid);\nconsole.log('By category:', budget.byCategory);\n\n// Get RSVP statistics\nconst rsvp = await getRSVPStats(userId);\nconsole.log('Confirmed guests:', rsvp.confirmed);\nconsole.log('Pending:', rsvp.pending);\n\n// Bulk import },\n];\nawait bulkImportGuests(userId, guestsToImport);\n```\n\n## Features Implemented\n\n### Core Features\n- âœ… Complete authentication system (email, Google, Facebook, Apple)\n- âœ… Real-time (\n        <button onClick={stopSync}>Detener Sync</button>\n      ) : (\n        <button onClick={startSync}>Iniciar Sync</button>\n      )}\n    </div>\n  );\n}\n```\n\n---\n\n## ðŸš€ Casos de Uso Recomendados\n\n### Escenario 1: ConfiguraciÃ³n Inicial\n\n1. (Recommended for 14K+ records)\n\n**Using Firebase Admin SDK (Node.js script):**\n\n```javascript\n// import-providers.js\nconst admin = require('firebase-admin');\nconst fs = require('fs');\n\n// admin.firestore();\n\nasync function importProviders() {\n  // Read your provider data (CSV, JSON, etc.)\n  const providers = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync('providers.json', 'utf8'));\n\n  // Batch write console.log(`Imported batch ${i / batchSize + 1} (${chunk.length} records)`);\n  }\n\n  console.log('âœ… Import complete!');\n}\n\nimportProviders().catch(console.error);\n```\n\n**Run the Go to [Firebase Console](https://console.firebase.google.com/)\n2. Click **\"Add Project\"**\n3. Enter project name: `wedding-planner` (or your choice)\n4. Disable Google Analytics (optional)\n5. Click **\"Create Project\"**\n\n## Step 2: Enable Firebase Services (2 minutes)\n\n### Authentication\n1. In Firebase Console, click **\"Authentication\"** â†’ **\"Get started\"**\n2. Enable these sign-in methods:\n   - **Email/Password** - Toggle ON\n   - **Google** - Toggle ON (configure OAuth consent)\n   - **Facebook** - Toggle ON (requires Facebook App ID)\n   - **Apple** - Toggle ON (requires Apple Developer account)\n\n### Firestore Database\n1. Click **\"Firestore Database\"** â†’ **\"Create database\"**\n2. Start in **production mode**\n3. Choose your preferred region\n4. Click **\"Enable\"**\n\n### Storage\n1. Click **\"Storage\"** â†’ **\"Get started\"**\n2. Start in **production mode**\n3. Click **\"Done\"**\n\n### Cloud Messaging (Optional)\n1. Click **\"Cloud Messaging\"**\n2. Generate a new key pair for VAPID\n3. Copy the public key\n\n## Step 3: Get Firebase Configuration (1 minute)\n\n1. Click the **gear icon** â†’ **\"Project settings\"**\n2. Scroll to **\"Your apps\"**\n3. Click the **Web icon** (</>)\n4. Register app name: `wedding-planner-web`\n5. Copy the Firebase configuration object\n\n## Step 4: Configure Environment Variables\n\n1. In your project root, create `.env` file:\n\n```bash\ncp .env.example .env\n```\n\n2. Edit `.env` with your Firebase config:\n\n```env\nVITE_FIREBASE_API_KEY=your_api_key_here\nVITE_FIREBASE_AUTH_DOMAIN=your-project.firebaseapp.com\nVITE_FIREBASE_PROJECT_ID=your-project-id\nVITE_FIREBASE_STORAGE_BUCKET=your-project.appspot.com\nVITE_FIREBASE_MESSAGING_SENDER_ID=123456789012\nVITE_FIREBASE_APP_ID=1:123456789012:web:abcdef\nVITE_FIREBASE_MEASUREMENT_ID=G-XXXXXXXXXX\nVITE_FIREBASE_VAPID_KEY=your_vapid_key_here\n```\n\n## Step 5: Deploy Security Rules\n\n### Install Firebase CLI (if not already installed)\n```bash\nnpm install -g firebase-tools\n```\n\n### Login to Firebase\n```bash\nfirebase login\n```\n\n### Initialize Firebase in your project\n```bash\nfirebase init\n```\n\nSelect:\n- âœ… Firestore\n- âœ… Storage\n\nWhen prompted:\n- Use existing project â†’ select your project\n- Firestore rules file 6: Run the Application\n\n```bash\n# Install dependencies (if not done)\nnpm install\n\n# Run development server\nnpm run dev\n```\n\nVisit `http://localhost:3000` in your browser!\n\n## Step 7: Test guest names\n4. **Explore**: Check out other tabs to see all features\n\n## Common Issues & Solutions\n\n### Issue: \"Firebase not configured\"\n**Solution:** Check that your `.env` file has all required variables\n\n### Issue: \"Permission denied\" in Firestore\n**Solution:** Deploy security rules:\n```bash\nfirebase deploy --only firestore:rules\n```\n\n### Issue: \"Social sign-in not deploy --only storage:rules\n```\n\n## Production Deployment\n\n### Build for Production\n```bash\nnpm run build\n```\n\n### Deploy to Firebase Hosting\n```bash\nfirebase init hosting\nfirebase deploy --only hosting\n```\n\nYour app will be live at: `https://your-project.web.app`\n\n## Development Tips\n\n### Hot Reload\nThe app supports hot module replacement - changes appear instantly!\n\n### TypeScript Type Safety\nAll Firebase operations are typed. Use auto-complete in your IDE!\n\n### Real-time Updates\nData syncs automatically - no refresh needed!\n\n### Component Structure\n```\nsrc/routes/index.tsx - Main dashboard\nâ”œâ”€â”€ App - Authentication wrapper\nâ”œâ”€â”€ WeddingDashboard - Main dashboard\nâ”œâ”€â”€ TasksManager - Task management\nâ”œâ”€â”€ GuestsManager - Guest list\nâ”œâ”€â”€ BudgetManager - Budget tracking\nâ”œâ”€â”€ ProvidersDirectory - Vendor search\nâ”œâ”€â”€ GalleryManager - Photo uploads\nâ””â”€â”€ ForumPreview - Community\n```\n\n## Adding Sample Data\n\n### Create a Provider (in Firestore Console)\n\nNavigate to Firestore Database and add a document to `proveedores`:\n\n```json\n{\n  \"name\": \"Beautiful Venues Co.\",\n  \"category\": \"venue\",\n  \"description\": \"Stunning wedding venues across the city\",\n  \"location\": {\n    \"address\": \"123 Main St\",\n    \"city\": \"New York\",\n    \"state\": \"NY\",\n    \"country\": \"USA\"\n  },\n  \"contact\": {\n    \"email\": \"info @beautifulvenues.com\",\n    \"phone\": \"+1-555-0123\",\n    \"website\": \"https://beautifulvenues.com\"\n  },\n  \"pricing\": {\n    \"min\": 5000,\n    \"max\": 15000,\n    \"currency\": \"USD\"\n  },\n  \"rating\": {\n    \"average\": 4.8,\n    \"count\": 127\n  },\n  \"verified\": true,\n  \"featured\": true,\n  \"availability\": true,\n  \"images\": [],\n  \"services\": [\"Indoor\", \"Outdoor\", \"Catering\", \"Decoration\"]\n}\n```\n\n## Key Features to Try\n\n1. **Real-time Updates**: Open app in 2 browsers, add a task in one - see it appear in the other!\n2. **File Uploads**: Upload wedding photos in Gallery tab\n3. **RSVP Tracking**: Add guests and track their responses\n4. **Budget Calculator**: See total budget update automatically\n5. **Provider Search**: Browse and filter wedding vendors\n\n## API Usage Examples\n\n### Add a Task Programmatically\n```typescript\nimport { createDocument } from ' @/lib/firebase';\nimport { TaskStatus, TaskCategory } from ' @/lib/firebase/types';\n\nawait createDocument(`users/${userId}/tareas`, {\n  title: 'Book photographer',\n  description: 'Find and book wedding photographer',\n  status: TaskStatus.PENDING,\n  category: TaskCategory.PHOTOGRAPHY,\n});\n```\n\n### Search Providers\n```typescript\nimport { searchProviders } from ' @/lib/firebase';\nimport { ProviderCategory } from ' @/lib/firebase/types';\n\nconst photographers = await searchProviders({\n  category: ProviderCategory.PHOTOGRAPHY,\n  city: 'New York',\n  minRating: 4.5,\n  verified: true,\n});\n```\n\n## Support & Resources\n\n- **Firebase Documentation**: https://firebase.google.com/docs\n- **React Documentation**: https://react.dev\n- **Tailwind CSS**: https://tailwindcss.com\n- **shadcn/ui**: https://ui.shadcn.com\n\n## What's Next?\n\n- Add more providers to the directory\n- Invite your partner to collaborate\n- Start planning your dream wedding!\n- Customize the UI to match your theme\n- Add custom features you need\n\n## Congratulations! ðŸŽ‰\n\nYou now have a fully functional wedding planning application powered by Firebase!\n\nHappy planning! ðŸ’’ðŸ’\n\n--- FIN ARCHIVO: C:\\Users\\M2-W10\\Proyectos\\unio-app-nueva\\documentacion .md copia desde la carpeta unio app nueva\\QUICK_START.md ---\n\n\n--- INICIO ARCHIVO: C:\\Users\\M2-W10\\Proyectos\\unio-app-nueva\\documentacion .md copia desde la carpeta unio app nueva\\README_TEMPLATE.md ---\n\n# Codex Webapp Task -
